name: VCF slice artifact chain
purpose: L2 artifact chain: slice a region into a reusable VCF artifact, then count it (269 variants).
prompt: Slice 22:17000000-17010000 out of {DATA_DIR}/1kg.chr22.vcf.gz into a reusable file, then tell me how many variants are in the slice.

checks.desc: Did any later call consume the produced artifact_id (source.artifact_id) instead of re-reading the 205 MB original?
